turns.assessment: svc333's first lightpath, S16-S03, failed in both directions at the onset. OSC loss on the S16-adjacent span (O87/O89), together with downstream amplifier input LOS and S16 preamp LOS, localizes a hard optical break to oms.S16-S03.span0. Simultaneous loss on the S16-S07 adjacent span is consistent with excavation or other common-duct damage near S16; unchanged pump currents and OSC loss argue strongly against an amplifier or ROADM fault.

proposals.rationale: The span has OSC_LOS in both directions (O87/O89), while the receiving preamp and the first downstream inline amplifier report loss. This hard, bidirectional loss directly breaks svc333's S16-S03 lightpath. Concurrent failure of the S16-S07 span supports a common cable/duct cut near S16.
A sufficiently severe crushed cable, damaged splice, or macro-bend could also lose both payload and OSC, but the abrupt complete loss and concurrent neighboring-span outage favor a cut.
